items.title: Hexagon releases next-generation OPTIV S 4.4.3 Optical CMM at IMTS
items.excerpt: Hexagon launched the redesigned OPTIV S optical CMM with tactile accuracy E0,MPEE=(1.6+L/200) μm, about 30% higher machine dynamics and about 15% shorter cycles in first application tests. PC-DMIS AI-assisted edge detection, autofocus and illumination features are being phased in through 2027.
items.query: Hexagon September 2026 AI metrology manufacturing OPTIV S

items.title: Hexagon completes acquisition of ZG Technology
items.excerpt: Hexagon acquired the remaining 49% of Wuhan ZG Automation Technology, taking 100% ownership of the 3D-scanning specialist. ZG scanners are used for quality inspection, reverse engineering and complex-part digitization including aerospace; Hexagon plans a unified handheld-scanning platform and Wuhan R&D center of excellence.
items.query: Hexagon ZG Technology acquisition September 7 2026 3D scanning aerospace

items.title: Accelerating AI Silicon Design with AI-Driven Flows
items.excerpt: Cadence describes AI-driven and emerging agentic automation embedded in TSMC-certified implementation, custom/analog, multiphysics, 3D-IC and signoff flows. It highlights Cerebrus optimization, Virtuoso agentic AI for advanced-node migration, and a shift from tool-by-tool execution toward goal-driven design workflows.
items.query: Cadence September 9 2026 AI-driven flows agentic design TSMC

items.title: How Many Design Experiments Does a Machine Learning Predictor Actually Need?
items.excerpt: Cadence reports four crash/safety studies showing CAE ML-predictor dataset needs track response smoothness more than model size or design-variable count. In one study, predictors drove 500 simulated-annealing iterations in minutes; the post recommends learning curves and predictor error bounds to govern solver-data budgets.
items.query: Cadence September 2026 machine learning predictor CAE design experiments

items.title: Advanced AI Scaling with 3D-IC and Heterogeneous Integration
items.excerpt: Cadence details a TSMC-aligned 3D-IC flow spanning chiplet/package planning, multiphysics thermal-power-EM analysis, physical verification and signoff. Integrity 3D-IC and Allegro X support TSMC 3DFabric/COUPE flows, linking early architecture decisions to tapeout-quality closure.
items.query: Cadence September 2026 3D-IC heterogeneous integration multiphysics TSMC

items.title: September 2026 Major Product Update – What’s New
items.excerpt: Fusion's September update moves Autodesk Assistant to general availability with natural-language bulk property edits, adds PMI creation consumed downstream in manufacturing, AI-oriented NETROUTE schematic automation, and expanded APIs including programmatic metal powder-bed FEA process simulation and result display.
items.query: Autodesk Fusion September 2026 major product update AI automation API simulation

items.title: New Capabilities in Marc 2026.1 You Should Be Using for Nonlinear Analysis
items.excerpt: Marc 2026.1 changes default nonlinear-contact handling with per-body-pair tolerances and tiny-segment filtering, unifies fixed time stepping with cut-back across thermo-mechanical and other multiphysics cases, and adds meshing, material-calibration and remeshing/postprocessing improvements.
items.query: MSC Software Marc 2026.1 nonlinear analysis August 23 2026

items.title: Romax 2026.1: A New Foundation for Drivetrain Simulation
items.excerpt: Romax 2026.1 previews a second-generation static-analysis solver, adds automated Ansys Maxwell excitation workflows for eNVH optimization, and accelerates external dynamic condensation with MSC Nastran; Cadence reports one example falling from 5,778 s to 1,498 s, a 74% reduction.
items.query: MSC Software Romax 2026.1 drivetrain simulation August 18 2026

items.title: Part 3: From Flow Simulation to Acoustic Insight with Cradle CFD and Actran
items.excerpt: Cadence MSC Software documents a hybrid aeroacoustic workflow in which Cradle CFD resolves unsteady flow and maps acoustic sources to Actran for propagation. Examples include open-rotor noise around an aircraft fuselage, jet-engine exhaust, short nacelle inlets and reusable CFD-derived source fields.
items.query: MSC Software Cradle CFD Actran aeroacoustics August 27 2026

items.title: New Version Announcements! VMC Manufacturing Solutions Are Now Available
items.excerpt: Cadence MSC Software announced Simufact Forming/Welding/Additive 2026.2 and related manufacturing releases. Updates include Python automation, automatic virtual-clamping generation from RPS definitions, additive scan compensation, adaptive mesh coarsening, PBF simulation performance work and Linux support.

items.title: Featured Speakers Announced for the COMSOL Conference 2026 Boston
items.excerpt: COMSOL announced a 2026 Boston conference program with Intel, Formula E, MIT, NASA Ames, GM and Cosmon, plus a panel on scaling AI-ready multiphysics workflows. The release explicitly highlights AI-assisted modeling and agentic workflows across aerospace, automotive, electronics and other engineering domains.
items.query: COMSOL September 2026 AI-ready multiphysics agentic workflows conference

items.title: Atos-powered agentic AI solution wins IDC AI Innovation Award
items.excerpt: Discovery candidate: Atos and Flender China built a sovereign engineering-R&D agent using agentic AI, RAG and multimodal inputs. Atos reports drawing/standard interpretation falling from ~30 to 5 minutes, 6× processing capacity and ~2,000 engineering hours saved yearly; the cross-industry engineering-agent pattern merits continued watch.
